gaps.statement: let x1 : SimpleGraph (Fin (11 : ℕ)) := PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.edgeGraph (11 : ℕ) [((0 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (4 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (6 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((7 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((8 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ))]; ∀ (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x3 : Finset (Sym2 (Fin (11 : ℕ)))) (x4 : Finset ℕ),   have x5 : Finset (Sym2 (Fin (11 : ℕ))) := PEqualNP.TopForm.Ustar x1 x2;   have x6 : Finset ℕ := PEqualNP.TopForm.junk x1 x2;   have x7 : ℕ → Finset (Sym2 (Fin (11 : ℕ))) := fun (x7 : ℕ) => x3 ∩ PEqualNP.TopForm.gammaE x1 x2 x7;   x2.size ≤ (21 : ℕ) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO x1 x2 → PEqualNP.TopForm.TopForm x1 x2 → (3 : ℕ) ≤ x6.card → x3 ⊆ x5 → x4 ⊆ x6 → x3.card + x6.card = x5.card + x4.card → (∀ x15 ∈ x3, ∃ x17 ∈ x4, x15 ∈ x7 x17) → (∀ x16 ∈ x4, (x7 x16).card ≠ (1 : ℕ)) → (∃ x17 ∈ x4, ∃ x18 ∈ x7 x17, ∃ x19 ∈ x7 x17, Disjoint x18.toFinset x19.toFinset) → x3.card ≤ (2 : ℕ) * (PEqualNP.TopForm.centreless x1 x2).card + x4.card + (PEqualNP.TopForm.orN x1 x2 \ PEqualNP.TopForm.lam x1 x2).card

gaps.statement: let x1 : Type := Fin (13 : ℕ); let x2 : Type := Finset x1; have x3 : x1 → x1 → Prop := fun (x3 x4 : x1) => x3 = x4 ∨ x3 = x4 + (1 : x1) ∨ x3 = x4 + (3 : x1) ∨ x3 = x4 + (9 : x1); have x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → x2 → x2 → Bool := fun (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x5 x6 : x2) => PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (26 : ℕ) x4 fun (x7 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Fin.addCases (fun (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x8 ∈ x5)) (fun (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x8 ∈ x6)) x7; have x5 : x2 → x2 → Prop := fun (x5 x6 : x2) => (∀ (x7 : x1), x7 ∈ x6 ↔ ∀ x8 ∈ x5, ¬x3 x8 x7) ∧ (∀ x7 ∉ x5, ∃ x9 ∈ x6, x3 x7 x9) ∧ (¬∃ (x7 : x1), ∀ x8 ∈ x5, x3 x8 x7) ∧ ¬∃ (x7 : x1), ∀ x8 ∈ x6, x3 x7 x8; have x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => (∀ (x7 x8 : x1), x3 x7 x8 → x4 x6 {x7} {x8} = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x7 x8 : x2), x5 x7 x8 → x4 x6 x7 x8 = Bool.false; have x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>   have x8 : ℕ := x7.lineDeg (26 : ℕ) (Finset.range (13 : ℕ));   have x9 : ℕ := x7.lineDeg (26 : ℕ) (Finset.Ico (13 : ℕ) (26 : ℕ));   (2 : ℕ) ≤ Min.min x8 x9 ∧ (3 : ℕ) ≤ Max.max x8 x9; have x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∃ x9 ∈ [(8191 : ℕ), (15860 : ℕ), (31200 : ℕ), (107904 : ℕ)], (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (26 : ℕ) x8 fun (x10 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => x9.testBit ↑x10) = Bool.true; ∀ (x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x9 → x6 x9 → x7 x9 → x8 x9 → (∀ (x14 x15 : Fin (26 : ℕ)), (¬∃ (x16 : x1) (x17 : x1), x3 x16 x17 ∧ (x14 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x16 ∧ x15 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x17 ∨ x15 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x16 ∧ x14 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x17)) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (26 : ℕ) x9 fun (x17 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x17 = x14 ∨ x17 = x15)) = Bool.false) → (64 : ℕ) ≤ x9.size

gaps.statement: have x1 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))}; have x2 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → List Bool := fun (x2 x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => (List.ofFn fun (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x4 = x2)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x4 = x3); have x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → List Bool := fun (x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => (List.ofFn fun (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x4 ∈ x3)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x5 ∈ x3, x5 - x4 ∉ x1); have x4 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Prop := fun (x4 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => x4.card = (4 : ℕ) ∧ ∀ (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x6 ∈ x4 | x6 - x5 ∈ x1}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ); ∀ (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x6 x7 : ℕ),   have x8 : ℕ → List Bool → Bool := fun (x8 : ℕ) (x9 : List Bool) => (x5.wires x9).getD x8 Bool.false;   (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x5 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x5 ∧ (∀ (x9 x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x9 - x10 ∈ x1 → (x8 x6 (x2 x9 x10) && x8 x7 (x2 x9 x10)) = Bool.true) ∧ (∀ (x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x4 x9 → (x8 x6 (x3 x9) && x8 x7 (x3 x9)) = Bool.false) ∧ (∃ (x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x4 x9 ∧ x8 x6 (x3 x9) < x8 x7 (x3 x9)) ∧ ∃ (x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x4 x9 ∧ x8 x7 (x3 x9) < x8 x6 (x3 x9)) → (¬∃ (x10 : ℕ) (x11 : ℕ), (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x5 x10).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x5 x11).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone (26 : ℕ) x5 x10 x11) → List.countP (fun (x11 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => x11.op.eval []) x5.gates ≤ (12 : ℕ) → (63 : ℕ) ≤ x5.size
